column2: (d) Where  the Authority  employs  any  person  who  has

column1: entered into a contract with the Government by which he has

column2: (1) The Authority may establish and maintain such

column1: departments as it may consider necessary for the proper and
efficient conduct of the affairs of the Authority.

column2: (2) The Authority shall determine the duties and functions

column1: to be assigned to each of the departments established under
subsection (1).

column2: (3) The Authority may with the concurrence of the Minister

column1: appoint  such  number  of  Committees  comprising  of  its
members  or  any  other  persons  possessing  appropriate
